title: Easy VBA: Create an Excel function to pull data from API and parse JSON
text:
Excel Easy VBA: Create an Excel function to pull data from API and parse JSON
I am looking for the exact VBA code that will allow me to do the following in Excel:
I want to have a custom function in Excel that references two other cells, one with the ticker of a stock eg AAPL and one with a date. The function should then pull the closing price of the stock on that date. The API I want to use for the code is AlphaVantage, they have a full documentation here: [login to view URL]
Everything is explained well in the documentation, but to be clear I want the function to return just the "close" price from the TIME_SERIES_DAILY API at a given date that is somewhere on spreadsheet and nothing else.
This should take no time at all for someone who knows what they're doing, unfortunately I have no experience with parsing JSON.
If there are any questions please let me know! I'll give a good tip if someone can do it quickly, thanks!
